narrative.overview: MACS Human Capital is a working tool for people who check records against paper forms all day, so the interface behaves like a well-kept register: a calm navy-grey page, white frames with exact edges, dense tables that stay readable, and one red seal that tells you where you are. Nothing decorates; everything that moves, fills or glows says something about state.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-grey ledger page with white surface frames; red is rare and meaningful.
Soft-lift cards for overview pages, thin borders where data is dense.
Forms are quiet soft boxes that edit on the spot; saves are per section.
Selection (navy-slate) and location (red) never share a colour; every state has a non-colour cue.
Motion is short and switches off for reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: Red marks where you are and the main action, nothing else.

rules.name: The Picked-Is-Navy Rule
rules.body: Navy-slate means what you picked, only on selected rows, checked boxes, chosen option and the selection bar.

rules.name: The Pairing Rule
rules.body: A tint always pairs with its own shade; both turn around in the dark theme.

rules.name: The Two-Cue Rule
rules.body: Every state carries a non-colour cue too.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, money is grouped with ₮, numbers right-align.

rules.name: The Mongolian-First Rule
rules.body: All visible text is Mongolian Cyrillic; labels are verbs; no browser dialogs.

rules.name: The Border-Where-Dense Rule
rules.body: Soft cards on overview pages, bordered frames on dense pages; never both on one surface.

rules.name: The Fast-Exit Rule
rules.body: 120 to 180 ms in, 140 ms out, never over 300 ms, never delay the action.

dos: Do use violet-* classes for the brand and red-* only for danger and errors.
Do use bg-surface / border-surface for any card or panel, never bg-white or #fff.
Do keep one Seal Red primary button per screen area, with Болих on its left.
Do show every state with a second cue (tick, bar, outline, underline), not colour alone.
Do keep empty states in a full-width row with text-slate-500 (not slate-400).
Do make a row that highlights on hover clickable across its whole width.
Do use the motion variables instead of literal durations, and honour reduced motion.
Do check any new screen at 375 px and in the dark theme, and add its rule to docs/UI_RULES.md.
donts: Don't use teal-, stone-, gray- or zinc- classes; they will not match the palette.
Don't use red for selected, navy-slate for status, or a new colour for a status that already has a badge.
Don't use circles for portraits, put a card inside a card, or mix soft cards and bordered frames on one surface.
Don't show confirm(), alert() or prompt(); use hrConfirm.
Don't show a native file input or a ---------- dropdown entry.
Don't put more than three buttons in a pop-up footer.
Don't underline a link inside a clickable row, and don't use slate-400 for text.
Don't hard-code a second font, a second accent, or motion over 300 ms.
